info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Interbank Relationship Management API
info.description: The Interbank Relationship Management API facilitates the dynamic updating of interbank relationship data, enabling banks to maintain current and accurate records of their partnerships. Users can modify relationship attributes, such as terms, conditions, and status, which are essential for operational efficiency and compliance. This API is typically utilized by financial institutions and banking software providers to manage and optimize their interbank interactions. By streamlining these operations, the API supports better decision-making and enhances the collaborative framework between banks.

patch.summary: Update an existing interbank relationship resource.
patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific interbank relationship identified by its resource ID. Providing the necessary changes will ensure the resource reflects the most current information, facilitating better management and integration.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the interbank relationship management details for a specific agency identified by RES-100045. It is essential to provide the necessary fields to reflect the updates in the agency's interbank relationship.
